businesses.business: natural gas utilities and energy services

offering_description.value: Delivers regulated natural gas distribution service to residential, commercial and industrial customers in New Jersey through New Jersey Natural Gas. Also operates clean energy projects (solar), natural gas storage and pipeline capacity, and wholesale energy marketing and services.

primary_products.value: natural gas; solar power; natural gas storage and transportation capacity

primary_services.value: regulated natural gas distribution; wholesale energy marketing and asset management; home appliance and HVAC services; energy efficiency programs

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential natural gas customers in New Jersey, home service customers; B2B: commercial and industrial gas users, utilities, marketers, producers

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial and industrial energy; utilities; renewable energy

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated tariff rates for gas delivered to utility customers; product sales: wholesale natural gas and solar energy and credits sold; service fees: asset management, storage and transportation capacity, home services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gas distribution pipelines, storage interests and solar facilities serving end customers; distributor: buys natural gas and delivers it to retail customers and wholesale marketers

geography_served.value: US national: Utility in New Jersey, wholesale marketing and pipeline/storage activity across North America

specialization.value: related lines: gas distribution, clean energy, storage and pipeline, energy marketing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility service billed directly to retail customers through pipeline network; direct sales: wholesale gas sold to utilities and marketers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utility overseen by the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, FERC and pipeline safety rules apply
